tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /stong nyid kyi rab tu dbye ba khyad par du 'phags pa zhes bya ba bzhugs/

oṃ gu ru buddha bo dhi satwe bhyo na mo na maḥ stong nyid kyi rab tu dbye ba khyad 'phags zhes bya ba/ pra phab brgyad dang mtshungs pa'i stong nyid zab mo la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /pad 'dab bcu drug dur khrod bcu drug dang*/ / phyag bcu drug dang ka ba bcu drug dang*/ /cha chen bcu drug stong nyid bcu drug la/ /btud nas stong nyid dbye ba khyad 'phags bri/ /rdzogs ldan gyi gzhung lugs dri ma med pa rnams su stong nyid gsungs pa rnams la/ bden gnyis la sogs pa'i rnam dbye ma shes na gzhan stong gis stong nyid kyi go mi chod pas stong nyid thams cad rang stong kho na yin pa'i phyir/ de bzhin nyid la sogs pa'i rnam grangs su gsungs pa'i stong nyid kyang rang stong kho nar 'dod pa'i lta ngan gyi dug sdong la brten nas/ lta log sna tshogs pa'i yal ga mang po rab tu rgyas par 'gyur bas/ de mi mkhas pa rnams la bstan pa'i don du 'di brtsam mo/ /stong nyid gsungs pa thams cad rang stong kho na ma yin gyi/ gzhan stong zab mo yin pa'i stong nyid dang*/ rang stong mi zab pa yin pa'i stong nyid du dbyer yod do/ /yang rnam pa gnyis te don dam yin pa'i stong nyid dang*/ kun rdzob yin pa'i stong nyid do/ /yang rnam pa gnyis te/ yongs grub yin pa'i stong nyid dang*/ kun brtags yin pa'i stong nyid do/ /yang rnam pa gnyis te/ dbus ma yin pa'i stong nyid dang*/ mtha' ma yin pa'i stong nyid do/ /yang rnam pa gnyis te/ rang bzhin gnyug ma yin pa'i stong nyid dang*/ bcos ma glo bur ba yin pa'i stong nyid do/ /yang rnam pa gnyis te/ chos nyid zab mo yin pa'i stong nyid dang*/ chos can mi zab pa yin pa'i stong nyid do/ /yang rnam pa gnyis te/ ma skyes pa'i stong pa nyid dang skyes pa'i stong pa nyid do/ /yang rnam pa gnyis te/ mi stong pa'i stong pa nyid dang*/ stong pa'i stong pa nyid do/ /yang rnam pa gnyis te/

gzhan gyi dngos po stong pa nyid dang*/ rang gi dngos po stong pa nyid do/ /yang rnam pa gnyis te/ dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang*/ dngos po med pa stong pa nyid do/ /yang rnam pa gnyis te/ rnam pa kun gyi mchog dang ldan pa'i stong pa nyid dang*/ phung po rnam par dpyad pa chad pa'i stong pa nyid do/ /yang rnam pa gnyis te/ gzhan mchog pha rol dam pa dang po'i sangs rgyas yin pa'i stong nyid dang*/ phyi nang kun rdzob glo bur ba 'di yin pa'i stong nyid do/ /yang rnam pa gnyis te/ stong gzhi yon tan mang po can ma yin dgag yin pa'i stong nyid dang*/ stong tsam sgrub chos tsam gyis dor ba med dgag yin pa'i stong nyid do/ /yang rnam pa gnyis te/ rang gis mi stong la chos gzhan thams cad kyis stong pa'i stong nyid dang*/ rang rang ngo bos stong pa'i stong nyid do/ /de bzhin du chos rnams kyi chos nyid yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ chos kyi gnas nyid yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ chos skyon med pa nyid yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ de bzhin nyid yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ ma nor ba de bzhin nyid yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ yang dag pa'i mtha' yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dbyings yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ yongs su mi nyams pa'i chos nyid yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ rtag tu btang snyoms su gnas pa yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes 'dus ma byas yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ chos thams cad du ma ro gcig yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ chos thams cad ni rang bzhin gyis dge ba/ kha na ma tho ba med pa/ zag pa med pa/ nyon mongs pa med pa/

rnam par byang ba/ 'jig rten las 'das pa/ 'dus ma byas rnams yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ dbye bsdu mang po can gyi rang bzhin gyi rigs yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ yon tan mang po can gyi bde gshegs snying po yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ de bzhin du dbu ma chen po yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ phyag rgya chen po yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ myang 'das chen po yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ 'od gsal chen po yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ byang chub chen po yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ sher phyin zab mo yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ 'gog bden zab mo yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ shin tu spros med yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ shin tu rnal 'byor yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ rdo rje'i rnal 'byor yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ lhan cig skyes sbyor yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ rang bzhin lhan skyes kyi bde chen yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ sbyang gzhi sbyangs 'bras yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ gshis lugs la yod med gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ 'gal 'dus skyon med yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ blang bya'am thob bya yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ skad cig dang rten 'brel dang rnam shes las 'das pa yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ rang byung ye shes yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ rdo rje'i theg pa yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ rdo rje'i lha yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ rdo rje'i sngags yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ rdo rjai'i rgyud yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ rdo rje'i phyag rgya yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/

rdo rje'i rgyu skar zla nyi khu rdul yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis gnyis dang*/ rdo rje'i rtsa rlung bshang gci yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis gnyis dang*/ rdo rje'i sha khrag rus pa yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis gnyis dang*/ rdo rje'i rkang tshil bu pags pa yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis gnyisadang*/ rdo rje'i skra spu sen mo la sogs yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis gnyis dang*/ rdo rje'i skar ma phra sbom dang 'ja' tshon phra rags dang sa rdo yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis gnyis dang*/ rdo rje'i char glog chu me yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis gnyis dang*/ rdo rje'i gza' bcu dang rlung bcu yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis gnyis dang*/ rdo rje'i lo zla ba bgrod pa yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis gnyis dang*/ rdo rje'i dus drug dus bzhi dus gsum yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis gnyis dang*/ rdo rje'i phyogs dang nyin mtshan dang chu tshod la sogs pa yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis gnyis dang*/ rdo rje'i phyogs bcu dang dbyibs mdog la sogs pa yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis gnyis dang*/ mdor na rdo rje'i phung po khams skye mched thams cad yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis gnyis dang*/ ye shes sku ste rang byung ba yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ thog ma bar dang mthar dge ba yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ rgyud chen sgyu 'phrul drwa ba yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ rdo rje 'chang chen gsang sngags 'chang yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ gsang sngags rgyal po drug ldan yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas a las byung yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ mchod pa chen po 'dod chags che yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ mchod pa chen po zhe sdang che yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/

mchod pa chen po khro pa che yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ mchod pa chen po chags pa che yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ 'dod pa chen po bde ba che yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ dga' ba chen po mgu ba che yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ gzugs che lus kyang che ba yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ kha dog che zhing lus bong che yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ ming yang che zhing rgya che ba yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ dkyil 'khor chen po yangs pa yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ nyon mongs chen po lcags kyu'i mchog yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ grags chen snyan grags chen po yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ mi mngon mi snang gsal byed mi snang ba chen po gsal ba che yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ mkhas pa sgyu 'phrul chen po 'chang yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ sbyin bdag chen po gtso bo yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ tshul khrims chen po 'chang ba'i mchog yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ bzod chen 'chang ba brtan pa po yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ brtson 'grus chen po brtul ba yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ bsam gtan chen po ting 'dzin gnas yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ shes rab chen po'i lus 'chang ba yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ stobs po che la thabs che ba yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ smon lam ye shes rgya mtsho yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ byams chen rang bzhin dpag med yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ snying rje chen po blo'i mchog yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ shes rab chen po blo chen ldan yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ mkhas pa chen po thabs che ba yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ rdzu 'phrul chen po stobs dang ldan yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/

shugs chen mgyogs pa chen po yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ mgon po rigs mchog chen po yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ bla ma gsang sngags che ba'i mchog yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ theg pa chen po'i tshul gyi mchog yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad che yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ thub pa chen po thub chen ldan yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ gsang sngags tshul chen bdag nyid can yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ pha rol phyin bcu thob pa yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ mgon po sa bcu'i dbang phyug yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ shes bcu rnam dag bdag nyid can yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ thub dbang stobs bcu khyab pa'i bdag yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ rnam bcu dbang ldan che ba po yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ de bzhin nyid bdag dag pa'i bdag yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ yang dag mtha' la rnam par gnas yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ bdag med seng ge'i sgra dang ldan yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ kun tu 'gro ba'i don yod stobs yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i yid ltar mgyogs yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ rgyal ba dgra rgyal rnam par rgyal yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ bde gshegs 'jig rten rig pa'i mchog yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ 'khor ba'i pha rol mthar son pa yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ bya ba byas pa bskam sar gnas yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ shes pa 'ba' zhig nges bsal ba yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ dam chos chos rgyal gsal bar ldan yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ 'jig rten snang bar byed pa'i mchog yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ chos kyi dbang phyug chos kyi rgyal yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/

legs pa'i lam ni ston pa po yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ don grub bsam pa grub pa yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ kun tu rtog pa thams cad spangs yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ rnam par mi rtog dbyings mi zad yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ chos dbyings dam pa zad mi shes yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ ye shes ldan pa yod med shes yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ tshogs gnyis tshogs ni bsags pa po yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ mchog gi dang po sku gsum 'chang yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ sangs rgyas sku lnga'i bdag nyid can yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ khyab bdag ye shes lnga'i bdag yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ sangs rgyas lnga bdag cod pan can yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ spyan lnga chags pa med pa 'chang yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ gcig pu sra mkhregs rdo rje'i bdag yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ skyes ma thag pa 'gro ba'i bdag yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ nam mkha' las byung rang byung ba yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ gsang sngags rgyal po don chen byed yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ sangs rgyas kun bdag dngos po mchog yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ gtso bo dkon mchog gsum 'dzin pa yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ don yod zhags pa rnam par rgyal yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ rdo rje 'jigs byed 'jigs par byed yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ khro bo'i rgyal po gdong drug 'jigs yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ gshin rje'i gshed po bgegs kyi rgyal yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ rdo rje shugs can 'jigs byed pa yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ rdo rje grags pa rdo rje'i snying yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/

sgyu 'phrul rdo rje gsus po che yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ rdo rje las skyes rdo rje'i bdag yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ rdo rje snying po mkha' 'dra ba yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ rdo rje sems dpa' sems dpa' che yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ rdo rje kun 'chang rdo rje can yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ rdo rje 'bebs pa 'bebs pa che yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ rdo rje phreng thogs dpal dang ldan yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ yi ge drug pa rdo rje'i sgra yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ 'jam dbyangs chen po sgra che ba yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ yang dag bdag med de bzhin nyid yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ yang dag mtha' ste yi ge med yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ chos kyi dung ste sgra chen ldan yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ chos kyi gaṇḍi sgra bo che yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ mi gnas mya ngan 'das pa po yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ phyogs bcu'i chos kyi rnga bo che yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ gzugs med gzugs bzang dam pa po yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan 'chang pa yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ skyabs dang skyob pa bla na med yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes mtsho yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ ma rig sgo nga'i sbubs 'byed pa yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ srid pa'i dra ba 'joms pa po yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho'i pha rol phyin yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ sgrib pa kun las nges par grol yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ mkha' ltar mnyam pa nyid la gnas yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ khyab bdag dam shes dam tshig ldan yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/

skyabs kyi dam pa skyabs su 'os yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ grol ba thar ba rnam grol lus yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ rdul med rdul bral dri ma med yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang/ nyes pa spangs pa skyon med pa yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ shin tu sad pa sad pa'i bdag yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ kun shes kun rig dam pa po yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ rnam par shes pa'i chos las 'das yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ gnyis med ye shes tshul 'chang ba yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ rnam par rtog med lhun gyis grub yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ dus gsum sangs rgyas sku 'chang ba yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ sangs rgyas thog ma tha ma med yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ dang po'i sangs rgyas rgyu med pa yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ ye shes mig gcig dri ma med yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ ye shes lus can de bzhin gshegs yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ dpal ldan rgyu skar dkyil 'khor yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ dpal ldan padma gar dbang phyug yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ sangs rgyas kun gyi sku 'chang ba yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rnal 'byor che yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ sangs rgyas kun gyi bstan pa gcig yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ 'jig rten dbang phyug kun gyi bdag yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ rdo rje 'chang ba kun gyi rje yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs che ba yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs la gnas yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ sangs rgyas kun gyi sku che ba yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ sangs rgyas kun gyi gsung yang yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/

rdo rje nyi ma snang ba che yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ rdo rje zla ba dri med 'od yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ chags bral dang po chags pa che yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ kha dog sna tshogs 'bar ba'i 'od yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ dpal ldan padma sangs rgyas skyes yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ kun mkhyen ye shes mdzod 'dzin pa yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ 'gyur med mchog ste rnam par dag yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ theg pa chen po sdug bsngal gcod yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ pha rol phyin pa kun rdzogs pa yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ yang dag ye shes zla 'od bzang yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ rgyud kun gyi ni bdag po mchog yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ ye shes sku rnams ma lus 'chang yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ kun tu bzang po blo gros bzang yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ sangs rgyas kun gyi snying po che yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas byang chub 'chang yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ ye shes me lce 'od rab gsal yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i yon tan mtsho yin min min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ rnam dag phung po lnga 'chang ba yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ yan lag bcu gnyis srid rtsa bton yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ dag pa rnam pa bcu gnyis 'chang yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ bden don rnam pa bcu gnyis ldan yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ de nyid rnam pa bcu drug yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ rnam pa nyi shus byang chub pa yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ skad cig gcig gis rdzogs sangs rgyas yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ sgyu 'phrul drwa bas mngon rdzogs pa'i byang chub yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/

sangs rgyas byang chub bla na med yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ stong pa chen po 'gyur med lnga yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ thig le stong pa 'gyur med drug yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ rnam pa kun ldan rnam pa med yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ bcu drug phyed phyed thig le 'chang yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ cha med cha las 'das pa po yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ bsam gtan bzhi pa'i rtse mo 'chang yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ ston pa gcig pu 'gro ba'i bla yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'jig rten 'dren yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ shes rab pha rol phyin pa'i mtha' yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ bdag rig gzhan rig thams cad pa yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ don gyi dam pa rnam dag dpal yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ yang dag mthar gyur yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ sangs rgyas byang chub yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ ye shes sku nyid yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ cha med kun 'gro yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ lus med rdo rje yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ rdo rje'i khu rdul yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ rdo rje'i phyogs gnyis yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ rdo rje'i bgrod pa gnyis yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ rdo rje'i ā li kā li yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ rdo rje'i dbyangs dang gsal byed yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ rdo rje'i sku gsung thugs ye shes yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ rdo rje'i dga' ba bzhi yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ rdo rje'i sku bzhi yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ rdo rje'i gdan bzhi yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ rdo rje'i de kho na nyid bzhi yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/

rdo rje'i skad cig ma bzhi yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ rdo rje'i he ru ka bzhi yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ rdo rje'i e waṃ ma ya bzhi yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ rdo rje'i sems dpa' bzhi yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ rdo rje'i gsang sngags bzhi yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ rdo rje padma yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ rdo rje bha ga yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ rdo rje bdud rtsi yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ rdo rje hūṃ mdzad yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ rdo rje rnam 'joms yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ rdo rje sgrol ma yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ rdo rje bdag med ma yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ rdo rje dbyings yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ sngags kyi dbyings yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ chos kyi dbyings yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ chos dbyings gsung gi dbang phyug yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ 'khor lo rgyud drug yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ mkha' 'gro lnga yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ dpal mchog dang po yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ de nyid 'dus pa yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ khams gsum rnam rgyal yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ don thams cad grub pa yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ 'gro ba 'dul ba yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ sgyu 'phrul drwa ba yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ rnam par snang mdzad mngon par byang chub pa yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ kyai'i rdo rje yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/

'khor lo bde mchog yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ gsang ba 'dus pa yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ dus kyi 'khor lo yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ dang po'i sangs rgyas yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ gzhi'i sangs rgyas yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ sangs rgyas kun bas sngar sangs rgyas yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ gdod nas grol ba'i de bzhin gshegs yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ rdo rje'i thig le gru gsum yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ rdo rje'i e waṃ yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ rdo rje'i haṃ kṣa yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ rdo rje a haṃ yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ 'khor 'das dbyer med yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ bden gnyis dbyer med yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ bden bzhi dbyer med yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ gzhi 'bras dbyer med yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ rgyu 'bras dbyer med yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ rnam shes ye shes dbyer med yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ yul dang yul can dbyer med yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ rten dang brten pa dbyer med yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ gtso bo gtso mo dbyer med yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ gtso 'khor dbyer med yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ yab yum dbyer med yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ pho mo dbyer med yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ theg gsum dbyer med yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ skyabs gsum dbyer med yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ dus gsum dbyer med yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ sku gsum dbyer med yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ sku bzhi dbyer med yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/

sku lnga dbyer med yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang*/ dbu ma sems tsam dbyer med yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis la sogs pa stong nyid kyi dbye ba rgya che rab 'byams yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rtogs nas mnyam gzhag la zlo ba'i gdams ngag zab mo la brten te/ don dam gzhan stong zab mo'i lam khyer dang*/ rjes thob shan 'byed pa'i man ngag la brten nas kun rdzob rang stong mi zab pa'i lam khyer nyams su len zhing gzhan dag la yang rgya cher yang dag par rab tu ston par gyur cig /gsum ldan mar bcad kyi chos slad can skyon can rang bzo can ma dag pa rnams la brten nas de ma yin la der 'dzin gyi gzhi lam 'bras bu lta sgom spyod pa dman pa rnams spangs te/ rdzogs ldan gyi chos mchog khyad 'phags rnams las gsungs pa'i gzhi lam 'bras bu lta sgom spyod pa rnam dag phun tshogs legs par rtogs shing nyams su len pa dang gzhan dag la yang rgya cher yang dag par rab tu ston par gyur cig /'di la brten nas kyang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' chen mo thams cad shin tu dgyes par gyur cig sangs rgyas sku gcig brnyes pas byin rlabs dang*/ /sangs rgyas sku gnyis brnyes pa'i byin rlabs dang*/ /sangs rgyas sku gsum brnyes pa'i byin rlabs dang*/ /sangs rgyas sku bzhi brnyes pa'i byin rlabs dang*/ /sangs rgyas sku lnga brnyes pa'i byin rlabs dang*/ /sangs rgyas sku drug brnyes pa'i byin rlabs dang*/ /sangs rgyas sku bdun brnyes pa'i byin rlabs dang*/ /rgyal sku bco brgyad brnyes pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /smon lam 'di dag ji bzhin 'grub gyur cig /ye shes rnam bzhi brnyes pa'i byin rlabs dang*/ /ye shes rnam lnga brnyes pa'i byin rlabs dang*/ /ye shes rnam dgu brnyes pa'i byin rlabs dang*/ /ye shes bcu bzhi brnyes pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /smon lam 'di dag ji bzhin 'grub gyur cig
